page_title: VIL 1-2 BET | Villarreal v Betis 13/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
90+5' 1 - 2 Goooooal! Youssouf Sabaly beats his man and slings in a cross towards Willian Jose (Betis), who evades his marker and plants a fine header inside the left post from close in. 1:2.
90+4' Willian Jose (Betis) attempts to chip the defensive wall, but they make the block.
90+4' The free kick will be taken by Willian Jose (Betis).
90+4' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alex Baena (Villarreal). Betis have a free kick from a promising distance.
90+3' Juan Foyth (Villarreal) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move. It's a free kick to Betis, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
90+1' Substitution. Guido Rodriguez did his best and is replaced by Paul Akouokou (Betis).
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
88' Guido Rodriguez (Betis) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias had an easy-decision to make.
87' Alex Baena (Villarreal) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
87' The ball is cleared after Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal have been awarded a corner kick.
85' The attendance for today's match is 17825.
85' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.
84' Guido Rodriguez (Betis) has an effort from distance but it's blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Betis will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
84' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ayoze Perez will be replaced by Andres Guardado (Betis).
84' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Gerard Moreno as he is replaced by Denis Suarez (Villarreal).
83' Quique Setien has decided to make a change. Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) replaces Ramon Terrats.
82' Willian Jose (Betis) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Filip Jorgensen makes a comfortable save.
79' Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent. A free kick is awarded to Betis.
76' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.

76' Alex Baena (Villarreal) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
75' Wonderful movement by Villarreal. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
73' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
71' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rodri (Betis) replacing Luiz Henrique.
71' It will be a substitution. Aitor Ruibal (Betis) is ready to enter the pitch as Isco walks off.
70' Aissa Mandi (Villarreal) receives a yellow card for infringement.
69' Luiz Henrique (Betis) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

69' Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
66' The resulting corner, taken by Alex Baena (Villarreal), comes to nothing.
65' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Good work from Villarreal as they win a corner.
63' Luiz Felipe (Betis) commits a rough foul. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias stops the game and makes a call. Villarreal are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
61' 1 - 1 Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal) celebrates a beautiful goal. He wins the ball inside the box from the free kick and plants a header inside the left post. 1:1.
61' Alex Baena (Villarreal) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
60' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias shows a yellow card to Luiz Felipe (Betis) for his blatant foul.
59' Alex Baena (Villarreal) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
57' Alex Baena (Villarreal) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
57' Here comes a substitution. Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) is brought on as a substitute for Santi Comesana.
56' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Villarreal force a corner. They send men into the box.
53' Alex Baena (Villarreal) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
52' A cross from the corner kick arrives close to the penalty spot. Juan Foyth (Villarreal) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the right post!
52' Corner kick. Alex Baena (Villarreal) is ready to send the ball into the box.

52' Villarreal are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Villarreal.
51' Juan Foyth (Villarreal) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
51' Ayoze Perez (Betis) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. It's a free kick to Villarreal in a dangerous position.
50' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) sends a long ball in, but Rui Silva comfortably gathers the ball.
48' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul. Betis have a free kick.
46' Good team movement sets up Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
46' A substitution has been made. Borja Iglesias is replaced by Willian Jose (Betis).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Villarreal comes to nothing.

45+5' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Villarreal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+5' Alex Baena (Villarreal) steps up to send the ball in.
45+4' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee blows his whistle, Villarreal are awarded a corner kick.
45+3' Betis fail to score from a corner as Filip Jorgensen (Villarreal) leaps to collect the ball.
45+2' Luiz Henrique (Betis) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
45+1' The corner is swung in but Betis can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

45' Ayoze Perez (Betis) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot towards the roof of the net, but the keeper makes a superb save! The ball is out of play. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner.
45' Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
44' The Betis players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball.
42' The ball is cleared after Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
41' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle as Isco (Betis) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
40' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Villarreal.
39' Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
38' Isco (Betis) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is out of play. Villarreal will have a throw-in.
36' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Guido Rodriguez (Betis) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
35' The sound of the whistle has almost been drowned out in the deafening atmosphere of this match. Isco (Betis) is setting the ball up for a free kick from mid-range.
35' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul after Alex Baena (Villarreal) hacks down one of his opponents. Betis earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
34' Abner (Betis) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Betis will take a throw-in.
31' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.

30' The game is interrupted. Santi Comesana (Villarreal) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Betis will take a free kick near the side line.
28' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for a foul after Borja Iglesias (Betis) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick to Villarreal.
27' Borja Iglesias (Betis) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
24' Quique Setien is forced to make a change. Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Alfonso Pedraza.
23' Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
23' Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal) takes the corner which is cleared.

22' Alex Baena (Villarreal) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.

20' 0 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Luiz Henrique, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Ayoze Perez (Betis), who beats Filip Jorgensen with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
19' Alex Baena (Villarreal) makes a rough challenge and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Betis.
17' Aissa Mandi (Villarreal) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
15' The goal by Villarreal won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
15' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
15' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Alex Baena (Villarreal) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
13' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Villarreal, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
13' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Ayoze Perez (Betis) and blew his whistle.
11' Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
10' Villarreal failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
10' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Villarreal get a corner.

8' A precise low pass is received by Abner (Betis), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
6' Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

5' A short pass finds Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
5' Villarreal take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
2' Villarreal control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Villarreal will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias.
